simulation_clock.expected_samples: integer seconds 0,1,...,86399; a missing second is an error and is not forward-filled
simulation_clock.q0_minus: Zero. SUMO begins at t=0 with an empty network and no preloaded vehicles. The FCD sample at t=0.00 is the state after departures at time 0, so it is not Q(0-).
simulation_clock.q_day_end: Q(86400-) is the occupancy at t=86399. No t=86400 snapshot is invented, copied, or filled from the flow balance.

physical_definition.inflow: Direct count of a vehicle entering a real edge in the 5-minute bin. Includes a departure or other first observation on that edge, a move from another real edge, and a return after the vehicle was observed off the edge. This is a source-inclusive entry count, not a pure upstream cordon count.
physical_definition.outflow: Direct count of a vehicle leaving a real edge: move to another real edge, observation on an internal lane, observation on an unknown lane, or a tripinfo arrival. Unfinished trips are not given an arrival.
physical_definition.accumulation_start: Q(300k-): real-edge occupancy at t=300k-1 for k>0, and 0 at k=0.
physical_definition.occupancy: A vehicle counts on the real edge of its lane at that exact sample. Internal lanes and unknown lanes are not kept on the previous external edge.
physical_definition.arrival_rule: impute_final_exits adds an outflow only when tripinfo has a finite arrival at or after depart. A missing arrival stays unresolved.
physical_definition.residual: accumulation_end - accumulation_start - inflow + outflow. Diagnostic only.
physical_definition.partial_rule: The same events and snapshots, restricted to a fixed vehicle list. Never full * p.
physical_definition.legacy: accumulate_states in generate_r_level_full_flow.py is the retired cumsum stock. New reads and writes do not call it.

speed.empty: C=0 stored as V=0 and means no valid snapshot
speed.stopped: C>0 and V=0 means every valid snapshot speed is zero
speed.filters: drop negative, non-finite, internal lane, unknown lane; keep speeds above the limit and above 40 m/s
speed.not: not the RF capped or limit-filled average_speed

count.not: not unique vehicles, not a cumulative daily count, and not divided by 300

derived.U: unique vehicles with at least one valid speed snapshot in the road-bin
derived.C_over_U: mean snapshots per such vehicle, only when U>0
derived.Vveh: mean over vehicles of each vehicle's mean snapshot speed; diagnostic weighting
